# Vendored Agent Plugins schemas

`1.0.0/plugin.schema.json` and `1.0.0/mcp.schema.json` are unmodified copies from [agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec](https://github.com/agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec) at commit `ff8ab5e392cc87bd88d87c060815a87490e51003`.

The spec project licenses schemas under the Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt` and the project's `LICENSE.md`).

`npm run validate:plugin` uses them offline. The specification text is authoritative when it conflicts with a schema, so the validator adds rules the schemas cannot express.
